name: Figma Make
desc: Prompt or design file into a code-backed prototype.
desc_zh: 从提示词或设计稿生成有代码支撑的原型
solves: A Figma file cannot be shipped. Make turns the design — or a sentence — into working code you can run and edit, keeping the design context attached.
solves_zh: Figma 文件交付不了。Make 把设计稿——或者一句话——变成能跑能改的真代码，同时保留设计上下文。
best_for: You are a designer who needs a working prototype, or a dev who wants to start from a real design file.
best_for_zh: 你是设计师，需要一个能跑的原型；或者你是开发，想从真实设计稿起步。
